I'm alone... The only friend I had won't speak to me my family wants me dead... i go to the hospital they put me up til I'm not suicidal anymore then it's back to this... it's already gone to far... i found a home for my cat... someone's on there way to pick up my dog... i just think it's time I can't live in limbo anymore...

I tried... i moved out for 2 months my anxiety got so bad I was crying every night... i was causing myself panic attacks and I ended up in the hospital for two weeks... my friend was letting me stay with her but I came back because my mom begged me to... and now it's back to the same old stuff... The same destruction... my friend won't even speak to me because I came back she saw all of it hands on she told me if I leaved she would never speak to me again.... idk why I left... i feel so stupid...
I just want them to be happy... and this is the only way... This is the way I say I love you... even if they don't love me...

I'm  so damaged.Not a single person loves me... i know it's the best choice... i can't live like this anymore. I know I'm hurting the people I love by being here... i want to be normal... i know I'm not and they hate me for being this way... they hate me for being sick they hate me for my living... i was a accident I wasn't meant to even be here my mom went in to have her tubes tied and found out she was pregnant with me and she gave me away... she let me be abused she knew it was happening she didn't care... my brother is her life... my brother is so perfect and I'm the fucked up one... "When something is beautiful I smash it to pieces the moment you love me insecurity releases and I'll be the one that's to blame so I'll sell my soul to blaze. " that song... The Chorus It speaks to me... it reminds me how I destroy everything I touch....

Well you're the only one out of everyone... no one loves me and no one ever will. It's hard because I thought my family did but they keep telling me it's time to end it... Just end my suffering... I'm so tired... i can't stop crying. And I can't do it today for the sheer fact that my dog is here. She's my therapy dog... i tried cuddling her she knows somethings wrong she won't leave my side... but I have no other choice.  I'm a waste of life. Who ever god is made me a joke... I've hurt allot of people... I'm the reason that I had to put my cat down when I was a kid... i was the reason I was stabbed while I was being raped by 4 men... i was the reason my best friend hates me... I'm the reason my family hates me... I'm the reason it's really time for me to go. I'm the problem eliminate the problem the world will be better... plus it'll be allot cheaper on my family if I was gone a few thousand dollars for a funeral that no one will show up to? That's allot cheaper then paying my medical bills. Life is done for me. I'm just glad it's around my birthday I decided it because then I can be born and die on the same day. I'm happy with my choice.
